idea-plugin.name: VeroScript GUI
idea-plugin.description:
VeroScript GUI markup and style editing, checking, application baking and standalone preview for JetBrains Rider.

Features

  • Edit .vswml markup and .vswcss styles with syntax highlighting and built-in suggestions.
  • Complete built-in controls, inherited properties, bindings, events, style properties and supported pseudo states.
  • Navigate local src references and update plain file paths through Rider file and folder renames.
  • Highlight inline script and style blocks, including CDATA sections.
  • Check GUI entries, preview them in a native application window, or bake source entries into .vsapp application packages.

Get started

  1. Install the VeroScript plugin, then install VeroScript GUI.
  2. Configure a matching GUI-enabled Runtime under Settings > Languages & Frameworks > VeroScript. Keep its GUI script libraries and required native providers installed together.
  3. Right-click a local .vswml, .vs or .vsapp entry and open VeroScript GUI to check or preview it. To bake a source entry, choose Configure GUI Application Baking, review the output and assets, then run the configuration.

Requirements and scope

Requires the VeroScript plugin and Rider 2026.2.2 (build 262.10315.191) or later within the 262 branch. GUI tasks use a separately installed, matching GUI-enabled Runtime. Local markup/style highlighting and built-in suggestions work without Runtime.

Preview opens a separate native window. This plugin provides no embedded visual designer, automatic reload or GUI-specific debug launch. External .vs files use the base plugin's language services. Inline script/binding semantics and custom widget schemas are not analyzed by this add-on; use Check GUI for native validation.

Documentation

The source checkout includes this plugin's user and developer guides in its Resources/Docs directory, in English, French, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
